intro: THE ROUGH SEA MAKES YOUR BOAT ROCK
HEAVILY.
FOR A WHILE YOU MANAGE TO FIGHT AGAINST
THE ROARING WAVES BUT SUDDENLY
A BREAKER CRASHES YOU
AGAINST THE ROCK IN FRONT OF YOU.
NOW YOU CANNOT BUT SWIM,
TO THE ISLAND.
IT IS LATE AFTERNOON. A FRESH
BREEZEE IS BLOWING FROM THE EAST ACROSS
THE DEVIL'S ISLAND.
YOU ARE WALKING ALONG THE STONY COAST
TOWARDS THE CENTRE OF THE ISLAND.
FURTHER AHEAD YOU MAKE OUT A HALF-
ROTTEN BRIDGE AND AT ITS END
A ROCK WHICH RESEMBLES A HUGE
SKULL. A CREEPY SILENCE IS SPREADING
AND THE AIR IS SMELLING FOUL.
AFTER FINDING YOUR WAY THROUGH THE
ALMOST IMPENETRABLE THICKET
YOU FIND YOURSELF STANDING IN FRONT OF
A HALF-ROTTEN TEMPLE-LIKE BUILDING.
YOU ASCEND THE LONG FLIGHT OF STONE
STAIRS AND FIND THE ENTRY HIDDEN
BEHIND CREEPERS...
STEEP ROCKS ARE TOWERING UP IN FRONT OF
YOU. COUNTLESS PEOPLE MUST HAVE DIED
WHEN THEY TRIED TO CLAIM UP THE ROCKS.
IT HAS GROWN VERY COLD NOW AND DARK
CLOUDS ARE DRAWING UP FROM THE EAST.
VERY DETERMINED YOU START CLAIMING UP
THE WALL.
JUST IN TIME BEFORE THE STARTING RAIN
MAKES THE ROCKS TOO SLIPPERY FOR YOU TO
CLAIM UP, YOU REACH THE RIM OF THE ROCKS
AND CATCH SIGHT OF THE DECAYED MASONRY
OF THE PIRATES AT ONCE...
